phase: edge-probe-set (product safety probes: lexical corruption must be ZERO)
design: Deterministic authored probes for every corruption class M29A observed (uppercase acronyms -> <unk>, @ -> <UNK>, punctuation inside URLs, truecasing damage) plus classes it predicted (decimals, dates, emoji, mixed script). PASS requires the word-preservation invariant AND no unk marker in the output.
